english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that is acceptable or okay, whether suitable or merely passable.
Use 可以 as the all-purpose casual choice when something is acceptable or okay, especially in an evaluation.

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 ho2 ji5 wo3

examples.english: This phone is still all right to use.
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 zung6 ho2 ji5 jung6
